protected_exclusions: raw learner prompts or chat transcripts
diagnosis, disability, accommodation, language-access, hardship, immigration, discipline, or counselling facts
security exploit strings, API keys, or tool-call payloads
small subgroup metrics that could identify learners or protected status
vendor marketing copy used as evidence

stop_conditions: protected support facts would enter a public example
evidence claims cannot be separated by family and expiry
public summary would imply effectiveness from SRC0 or SRC1 material
source owner cannot confirm the source class or field meanings
owner can only provide a full export or raw learner trace packet
owner packet workbench cannot be completed without raw learner, protected, or security payload details
first-packet decision board is missing, blank, or cannot identify an authority/evidence/construct/public/lifecycle effect
post-decision change ticket is missing, blank, lacks rollback owner/triggers, or authorizes a broader change than the board decision supports
